ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level ratio; approximately 85% high-intensity white/light-grey pixels against 15% low-intensity black pixels localized primarily on trailing edges and central notch.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous low-intensity black border along the trailing edge of both lobes. Significant vertical dark band adjacent to the median notch. Small, discrete circular and irregular dark clusters scattered across the right lobe. Single rectangular/angular dark cluster on the lower-mid section of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression; approximate interior angle of 45 degrees relative to the horizontal plane of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-to-medium amplitude serrations across the entire visible trailing edge. Multiple jagged peaks and shallow valleys create an irregular, non-linear boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Visible segments of the trailing edge exhibit a slight upward convexity from the median notch moving laterally towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of several small, roughly circular low-intensity clusters on the mid-to-outer region of the right lobe, consistent with rosette-style scarring.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Prominent vertical linear disruption on the mid-left lobe; secondary thin diagonal linear marks scattered across the surface of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct dark vertical marking extending from the peduncle into the notch area. Prominent L-shaped dark mark on the lower-left fluke surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Characteristic L-shaped/angled pigmentation mark located in the lower-left quadrant of the visible ventral surface.
